posts.author: Zliryu
posts.body:
Hi.
I am Dejan You, freelance game developer (C++ and Blueprint Scripting in UE4/5) and writer (Ervenfell Universe).
It's been 25 years (not sure what month
) since I started game dev.
Started with rpg maker 2k and game maker 3.1 (I think, might be 3.0).
Figured I’d give something back.
Made a simple world map plugin that fires when you hold M. Shows player location and quest location on a map.
Use/modify/download freely, no strings attached.
https://dpb-ryu.itch.io/simple-world-map
Have fun developing
Laters (I am not often here, hope this is the right place to post this).
